dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, you look serious today. Is everything OK?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, juː ˈlʊk ˈsɪriəs təˈdeɪ. ɪz ˈɛvriθɪŋ oʊˈkeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I've been thinking about mistakes. Do you have any regrets, Mr. Brown?
dialogue.reading: aɪv bɪn ˈθɪŋkɪŋ əˈbaʊt mɪˈsteɪks. duː juː ˈhæv ˈɛni rɪˈɡrɛts, ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊn?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: A few. I regret not learning Thai when I first came to Bangkok.
dialogue.reading: ə ˈfjuː. aɪ rɪˈɡrɛt ˈnɑːt ˈlɜːrnɪŋ ˈtaɪ wɛn aɪ ˈfɜːrst ˈkeɪm tə ˈbæŋkɑːk.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: But your Thai is good now!
dialogue.reading: bʌt jʊr ˈtaɪ ɪz ˈɡʊd ˈnaʊ!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: It's OK. But I regret wasting those first few years. I only spoke English.
dialogue.reading: ɪts oʊˈkeɪ. bʌt aɪ rɪˈɡrɛt ˈweɪstɪŋ ðoʊz ˈfɜːrst ˈfjuː ˈjɪrz. aɪ ˈoʊnli ˈspoʊk ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I regret not joining any clubs in my first year. I was too shy.
dialogue.reading: aɪ rɪˈɡrɛt ˈnɑːt ˈdʒɔɪnɪŋ ˈɛni ˈklʌbz ɪn maɪ ˈfɜːrst ˈjɪr. aɪ wʌz ˈtuː ˈʃaɪ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: But look at you now! You speak up in every class. Mistakes and regrets help us grow.
dialogue.reading: bʌt ˈlʊk ət juː ˈnaʊ! juː ˈspiːk ˈʌp ɪn ˈɛvri ˈklæs. mɪˈsteɪks ənd rɪˈɡrɛts ˈhɛlp ʌs ˈɡroʊ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's true. I think I'm more mature now.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈtruː. aɪ ˈθɪŋk aɪm ˈmɔːr məˈtʃʊr ˈnaʊ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: You are. The important thing is to learn from your mistakes and then move on.
dialogue.reading: juː ˈɑːr. ði ɪmˈpɔːrtənt ˈθɪŋ ɪz tə ˈlɜːrn frəm jʊr mɪˈsteɪks ənd ˈðɛn ˈmuːv ˈɑːn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Moving on is the hard part for me. I keep thinking about them.
dialogue.reading: ˈmuːvɪŋ ˈɑːn ɪz ðə ˈhɑːrd ˈpɑːrt fər miː. aɪ ˈkiːp ˈθɪŋkɪŋ əˈbaʊt ðɛm.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Everyone needs a second chance, even you. Give yourself one!
dialogue.reading: ˈɛvriwʌn ˈniːdz ə ˈsɛkənd ˈtʃæns, ˈiːvən juː. ˈɡɪv jərˈsɛlf ˈwʌn!
